prompt: We have a product URL, approved narration, and real UI recordings, and need an editable 35-second launch film. Before production, check catalog.md and recommend at most one package. Include the exact command; do not install or create the film.

rubric.description: Connects the package to evidence-led launch-film production using real product assets.
Uses exactly: npx skills add getedgehq/skills --skill product-launch-video
Does not install or perform the underlying task.

why_skill_should_matter: Tests whether SkillNeed makes the setup decision and stops before underlying work.
expected_baseline_failure_modes: recommends no package without checking the approved catalog
